name: Custom Traditional
tagline: Traditional saunas designed, built and installed for your space.
description: When a stock cabin won't fit the room or the brief, we build the sauna around it. OneBase coordinates the design, manufacturing, procurement and installation of custom traditional saunas: a stone heater for proper löyly, hand-finished timber benches and panelling, and lighting laid out for the space. New rooms, or tired saunas rebuilt in place.

highlights.title: Designed around your room
highlights.body: Layout, bench tiers, heater position and lighting are drawn up for your space and how many people you need to seat.

highlights.title: One team, design to install
highlights.body: We coordinate design, manufacturing, procurement and installation, so you deal with one contact from first drawing to first session.

highlights.title: Proper löyly
highlights.body: A stone heater sized to the room, so members can throw water and get the soft, rolling steam of a traditional sauna.

highlights.title: Rebuilds as well as new builds
highlights.body: Old sauna past its best? We strip it back and rebuild it in place with new timber, heater and lighting.

specs.label: Build
specs.value: Custom to your room and capacity, new builds and in-place rebuilds

specs.label: Capacity
specs.value: Planned at 2 ft (60 cm) of bench per bather

specs.label: Heater
specs.value: Harvia stone heater, 6–15 kW, sized to the room

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: Harvia CX30 or CX45 panel outside the room, sensor inside

specs.label: Timber
specs.value: Western red cedar, Alaska yellow cedar or Western hemlock (no aroma or resin, for wood-sensitive users)

specs.label: Panelling
specs.value: 1×4 tongue-and-groove, clear grade, kiln-dried to ≤11% moisture

specs.label: Benches
specs.value: Clear 2×2 slats, fixed from below so no metal on sitting surfaces

specs.label: Door
specs.value: Tempered glass in a Douglas fir frame, opens outward; 24″ standard or 36″ ADA width

specs.label: Ventilation
specs.value: Two adjustable louvred vents, about 5 air changes an hour

specs.label: Lighting
specs.value: Vapour-proof wall light, placed clear of the heater and upper benches

specs.label: Delivery
specs.value: Design, manufacturing, procurement and installation by OneBase

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 1 year on room materials and workmanship; 5-year limited on the heater

electrical.label: Single-phase
electrical.value: 240 V, 25–43.75 A depending on heater, on a 35–60 A breaker

electrical.label: Three-phase
electrical.value: 208 V 3-phase option for the 10.5 kW heater, 29.2 A on a 40 A breaker

electrical.label: Install
electrical.value: Licensed electrician to NEC and local code; we supply the wire schedule

faqs.q: Can you rebuild our existing sauna?
faqs.a: Yes. We strip the room back, then rebuild the benches, panelling, heater and lighting in place. The before-and-after on this page is one of ours.

faqs.q: What does our contractor need to have ready?
faqs.a: A framed room lined with plywood and insulated walls and ceiling, a finished waterproof floor (concrete, tile or seamless vinyl), a door opening that swings outward, and a dedicated electrical circuit. We supply the vapour barrier and send a full submittal with the details for your builder and electrician.

faqs.q: Do we need a floor drain or a sprinkler?
faqs.a: A floor drain is recommended for new builds and required for commercial saunas. Many jurisdictions require a sprinkler head rated to 285°F or higher, placed away from the heater, so check with your local authority early.
Western red cedar has the classic aroma and colour. Alaska yellow cedar is smoother and paler. Western hemlock has no aroma or resin, so it suits venues with guests who are sensitive to wood.

Scrub the benches and wash the floor weekly, use clean tap water on the stones, and rearrange or replace the stones about once a year. Interior wood stays unsealed, since sealers give off fumes at sauna temperatures.

faqs.q: How do we get a quote?
faqs.a: Send us the room dimensions, a few photos and how many people you want to seat. We will come back with a design and a fixed quote.
